extension.description: Generate Git commit messages from staged changes using AI.
command.generate.title: Git Commit Assistant: Generate Commit Message
command.cancel.title: Git Commit Assistant: Cancel Generation
command.setApiKey.title: Git Commit Assistant: Set API Key
command.clearApiKey.title: Git Commit Assistant: Clear API Key
configuration.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API URL. Root URLs and URLs ending in /v1 use /chat/completions automatically. You can also enter a complete /chat/completions, /responses, or custom third-party endpoint.
configuration.model.description: Model name used to generate commit messages.
configuration.requireApiKey.description: Whether an API key is required. Disable this for unauthenticated local services such as Ollama.
configuration.language.description: Language used for generated commit messages.
configuration.useConventionalCommits.des: Require generated messages to follow the Conventional Commits format.
configuration.customInstructions.descrip: Additional commit-message instructions, for example: `Keep the subject under 50 characters`.
configuration.maxDiffCharacters.descript: Maximum number of staged diff characters sent to the model. Additional content is truncated.
